C0112.title: Hangzhou Penalizes False Advertising in Livestreaming
C0112.summary: In February 2021, the Yuhang District Market Supervision Administration of Hangzhou imposed an administrative penalty of 200,000 yuan on Hangzhou Yuyou Culture and Art Co., Ltd. for false advertising. The company's contracted host made claims about a product's weight-loss effects during a livestreaming sales session but could not provide supporting evidence, misleading consumers.
